title: Finite-free compact-support coefficient comparison and composition
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$ and a prime $\ell\ne p$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Let $E\subset L$ be finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, with valuation rings $R,S$, uniformizers $\pi,v$, and ramification index $e$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For $n\ge1$ put $A_n=R/\pi^n$ and $B_n=S/\pi^nS=S/v^{en}$, a finite free $A_n$-algebra [lem-coef-finite-free-extension]. Let $X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow gZ$ be separated finite-type morphisms of separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Work with ordinary constant-coefficient module sheaves on fixed small pro-etale skeletons [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention]. For $C=A_n,B_n$ use the full subcategory $D^b_{ctf}(W,C)$ of bounded constructible complexes of $C_W$-modules having finite Tor amplitude: there exist integers $a\le b$ such that tensoring with any degree-zero $C_W$-module sheaf has cohomology only in $[a,b]$ [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility, def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. Put $T_{W,n}=-\otimes_{A_n}^LB_n$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Fix compactifications for $f,g,gf$, and let $F_{h,C}=Rh_{!,C}$ be the compact-support functors defined by $Rp_*j_!$ [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed]. Use the bounded constructible etale-origin realization of [lem-sf-proetale-constructible-origin]. Let $\gamma_{g,f,C}:F_{g,C}F_{f,C}\xrightarrow{\sim}F_{gf,C}$ be their canonical compact-support composition isomorphisms [thm-sf-comp-composition]. For $h=f,g,gf$, let $\alpha_{h,n}:T_{\operatorname{target}(h),n}F_{h,A_n}\xrightarrow{\sim}F_{h,B_n}T_{\operatorname{source}(h),n}$ be the canonical finite-free comparison, obtained by composing the open-extension tensor comparison and the proper direct-image projection comparison of [lem-coef-finite-free-extension]; after forgetting $B_n$-coefficients its map in a finite free basis is finite-sum distributivity. Then, for every $K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A_n)$, the following equality of specified maps $T_{Z,n}F_{g,A_n}F_{f,A_n}K\to F_{gf,B_n}T_{X,n}K$ holds:
$$\gamma_{g,f,B_n,T_{X,n}K}\circ F_{g,B_n}(\alpha_{f,n,K})\circ\alpha_{g,n,F_{f,A_n}K}
=\alpha_{gf,n,K}\circ T_{Z,n}(\gamma_{g,f,A_n,K}).$$
For a normalized derived $A_n$-coefficient system $K_\bullet$ whose levels lie in these finite-Tor constructible categories, the same equation is an equality of the specified maps in the simultaneous derived semilinear-section models of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. Here normalized means that every transition-adjoint map $K_m\otimes^L_{A_m}A_n\to K_n$ for $m\ge n$ is an isomorphism. The maps use the strict quotient transitions and one fixed $R$-basis of $S$ reduced at every $n$; the assertion is about these coherent constructions before total limit, not equality inferred solely from equality at each evaluation.
